Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A general knowledge quiz show approached a line cook and a chemical engineer about being contestants. Both had to take a test beforehand to see if they should be on the show. The line cook got nearly every answer wrong and was excluded because they wouldn't be a good contestant, but the chemical engineer scored well and was selected. Who is unintelligent?
A. The chemical engineer
B. The line cook
C. Not answerable
